name: dsh-plugins-cooper-custom

scripts.build: pnpm --dir packages/dsh-cross-memory build && pnpm --dir packages/dsh-session-ops build && pnpm --dir packages/dsh-rtk-slim build && pnpm --dir packages/dsh-folder-path build && pnpm --dir packages/dsh-open-in-dsh build
